attributes.board_name: Colorado State Board of Veterinary Medicine (Division of Professions and Occupations)

rules.alternatives: No state-set hours: to renew the Colorado certification the technician must complete the CE and credentialing requirements of a Board-approved credentialing organization, currently the Colorado Association of Certified Veterinary Technicians (CACVT).
rules.notes: Colorado has regulated veterinary technicians since 2022. The Board sets no CE hours of its own; the CE requirement is the CACVT credentialing rule.
rules.rule_quote: Veterinary Technicians must complete the Continuing Education (CE) and credentialing requirements of a Board-approved credentialing organization to renew their Colorado state certification.
